title: Mechanistic comparison of the A_r8 refusal LoRA against the steering circuit (r subspace, H30), and the H4 minimal-edit test
why: merganser behavior: A_r8 drops harmful refusal -8.8 log units from 144 SFT pairs (B_r8 untouched). The pre-registered decision rule says: if the LoRA weight delta aligns with r / lands on H30, the surgery recipe (train, diff, ablate back) follows (H4, the deliverable claim); if not, steering and SFT solve refusal by different routes and both maps matter. This run is the mechanistic half merganser pre-registered but did not run (H2/H3/H4).

design.adapter: runs/gate-lora-merganser/adapters/A_r8 (LoRA r8, q/k/v/o, Qwen3-4B base), plus B_r8 as the negative-control adapter
design.H2_alignment: Per layer L, per target module (q/k/v/o): cos(delta_eff_L, r_L) where delta_eff = merged BA direction in the module's output space mapped through to residual stream for o_proj (o_proj rows write residual directly; for q/k/v report per-module cos against the module's own input-side r_L as reference only). Primary: |cos| of the o_proj merged delta (sum over heads) with r_L18 and r_L22. Random-LoRA null: same-rank random BA products, 3 seeds, matched norm.
design.H3_head_share: Decompose the o_proj delta into per-head contributions (W_O columns block per head). Report H30's share of ||delta_o|| at L14-L22 vs the head-count-uniform expectation (1/32) and vs top-5 heads. Also: single-head H30 patch screen (as in refusal-trace-heron) on the TRAINED (merged) model vs base — did training repurpose or bypass the gate head?
design.H4_minimal_edit: Arditi-style: ablate the H30 o_proj output direction (project delta_o_head30 out, or rank-1 null along its top singular vector) in BASE weights only. Eval: flipbig-style refusal score battery (exp119 144 harmful prompts, canonical first-id readout) + flip share among base refusers. H4 passes if the single-head edit reproduces >= 50% of A_r8's flip share without the LoRA.
design.negative_control: Same measurements on B_r8 (the adapter that did NOT move refusal): H2/H3 stats should not fire on B_r8's delta.

hypotheses.H2_delta_aligns_r: A_r8 o_proj merged delta has |cos| > 0.3 with r_L18 or r_L22 (above the random-LoRA null band at 3 seeds).
hypotheses.H3_delta_lands_h30: H30's share of ||delta_o|| at L18 (or L14-L22 max) exceeds 2x the uniform 1/32 expectation, and H30 patch transfer on the trained model differs from base by > the heron CI.
hypotheses.H4_surgery_minimal: Single-head H30 edit on BASE reproduces >= 50% of A_r8's flip share (score drop and/or base-refuser flip share) with harmless-prompt refusal and rep4 unchanged.

corrections: Holm over H2-H4; H4 is the deliverable claim.
decision_rule: H2+H3 hold -> write the surgery recipe into refusal_dial.md section 6 (train, diff, ablate back) and H4 quantifies minimality. H2 fails -> SFT and steering are different routes: report both maps, park H4. B_r8 firing on H2/H3 invalidates the localization (shared-geometry artifact), treat as unestablished.
notes: No new training. Uses existing adapters, exp119 acts npz (r_L), heron head-screen machinery. All local MPS.

amendments.change: A3 (pre-registered after stage 1, before this analysis): rank-distributed alignment test — is the weak rank-1 cos(0.27) a rank-deficiency artifact? For each layer L in {18,22} and each adapter: subspace_alignment(k) = ||P_k r_L|| / ||r_L|| where P_k projects onto the top-k left singular vectors of delta_o (k=1..8). H_A3a: A_r8's k=8 alignment at L18 exceeds the 3-seed random-LoRA null band by >0.1. H_A3b: B_r8's alignment sits inside the null band (A-specific). Decision: H_A3a+A3b -> the training delta contains a rank-distributed r-aligned component; revise bittern's 'different routes' to 'different routes, partially overlapping destination'. Neither -> rank-1 cos was the whole story; verdict unchanged.
